title: Church age of Ephesus (the Nicolaitans) begins
summary: Johnson reads the seven letters of Revelation 2–3 as seven successive ages of church history. He starts Ephesus at Pentecost, AD 32, so this age had begun before John wrote.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed, Apostasy of the Church: Seven Church Ages

title: Church age of Smyrna (the Synagogue of Satan) begins
fulfilment: Church history: the age of Roman persecution
summary: Johnson dates the persecuted church age of Smyrna from AD 64, the year Nero began persecuting Christians.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed, Apostasy of the Church: Seven Church Ages

title: Church age of Pergamos (Balaam's stumbling block) begins
fulfilment: Church history: Constantine and the state church
summary: Johnson dates Pergamos from AD 312, and ties to it the rise of amillennialism, cessationism and church tradition.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed, Apostasy of the Church: Seven Church Ages

title: Church age of Thyatira (Jezebel, depths of Satan) begins
summary: Johnson dates Thyatira from AD 606, and ties to it the errors he lists under Jezebel's idolatry.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed, Apostasy of the Church: Seven Church Ages

title: Church age of Philadelphia (the missionary church) begins
summary: Johnson dates the missionary church of Philadelphia from AD 1750. His contents page gives no year for Sardis, the age before it.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed, Apostasy of the Church: Seven Church Ages

title: Church age of Laodicea (the lukewarm church) begins
summary: Johnson dates the lukewarm church of Laodicea from AD 1948, the year Israel was reborn. It is the last age before the Rapture.

sources.name: Ancient Prophecies Revealed, Apostasy of the Church: Seven Church Ages
